dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You two seem to get on really well.

dialogues.speaker: Sun Yu
dialogues.text: I've always treated her like a sister...

dialogues.speaker: Sun Yu
dialogues.text: We've always been inseparable when practicing martial arts, like a form to its shadow. I consider us equally matched, both in combat and in courage.

dialogues.speaker: Sun Yu
dialogues.text: Hence, I brought her here with me, that we might search for divine guidance and bring about the Guhua renaissance together.

dialogues.speaker: Sun Yu
dialogues.text: She has an odd temperament, normally being prone to chatter... Yet with me, she is like a completely different person. I find this a bit of a headache to comprehend.
